Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer, Conservative party leader Kemi Badenoch and Reform UK leader Nigel Farage have issued separate statements after Devon and Cornwall Police announced a murder investigation into the death of Ann Widdecombe.

The Reform UK spokeswoman and former Conservative minister was found dead at her Dartmoor home on Thursday morning.

In a press conference, Assistant Chief Constable Matt Longman said a 26-year-old man was in custody,
